name: Iconoclasm
overview: Scripture clearly commands the removal and destruction of idols and pagan images as a demonstration of faithfulness to the one true God. Leaders such as Jacob and Moses exemplify this by urging the purging of strange gods and breaking down altars and images associated with idolatry. The passages emphasize complete eradication—overthrowing, burning, grinding to powder, and plucking down high places—as necessary actions to maintain covenant purity and obedience. This reveals a consistent biblical mandate to reject idolatry in all its forms and to uphold exclusive worship of God alone.
